Class MatchSettings

java.lang.Object
com.cuseto.pong.config.MatchSettings
public final class MatchSettings extends Object
The subset of match settings a player can edit from the options menu: winning score, ball and paddle speed, and whether ball speed increases on paddle bounces.

This is a plain validated value holder, distinct from the configuration schema records; applyTo(AppConfig) merges these values into an existing AppConfig, leaving arena, paddle size/inset, and ball radius untouched.

  • Constructor Details

    • MatchSettings

      public MatchSettings(int winningScore, double ballSpeed, double paddleSpeed, boolean ballSpeedIncreaseEnabled)
      Creates a validated set of match settings.
      Parameters:
      winningScore - the score a player must reach to win the match; must be positive
      ballSpeed - the ball's initial horizontal and vertical speed, in units per second; must be positive and finite
      paddleSpeed - the paddles' movement speed, in units per second; must be positive and finite
      ballSpeedIncreaseEnabled - whether the ball's horizontal speed increases on each paddle bounce
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if winningScore is not positive, or if ballSpeed or paddleSpeed is not positive and finite

    • applyTo

      public AppConfig applyTo(AppConfig config)
      Returns a copy of config with this object's winning score, ball speed, paddle speed, and speed-increase flag applied. Arena spacing, paddle size/inset, ball radius, viewport, and controls are carried over unchanged from config.
      Parameters:
      config - the configuration to merge these settings into; must not be null
      Returns:
      a new AppConfig with these match settings applied
